items.title: 68098_Snub Mosley oral history interview
items.q: Interviewer mentions Vernon King; Interviewee responds only to confirm he worked with Jeter & Pillars, without indicating a personal or professional connection to the interviewee.

ctx.x: I wish I had this list-- I got the list of my recordings. I've got it here, if you could stop that thing.
Vernon King was from St. Louis, I'm trying to think where you got him from, although he worked with Jeter&Pillars down in St. Louis.
I think he worked with Jeter&Pillars after.
